scenarios.title: Fault soak: control socket replies arrive late (the 14 timeouts of the quest log); the monitor is the oracle

assert.why: the hero is alive and at least at its start level; the verdict is the invariant monitor (hard rows turn the run RED), not progress

scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: level 12, 500 gold, potions and the field start (Blood Moor) by SETUP verbs; the run goes through the fault proxy (cmd/d2scenario/faults.json), so it is never a gate or baseline row. Mechanics and recovery evidence only.
scenarios.notes: Lab soak (card faultsoak, docs/probes/faultsoak-design-2026-11-26.md). Report-only: ids under soak.fault. are in invariants.json report_only. Run: d2scenario soak -id soak.fault. -duration 1h. Each hit becomes an incident scenario by hand.
